integrity: Analytic equivariant deformation and group-character calculation provide the infinite proof. A finite standard-library checker independently tests cycle matrices and 11820 group elements; finite computations are not treated as the general proof.
limitations: Exactly two ordered collision-free points on equilateral finite stars; rational irreducible splitting only; no claim about higher-particle or modular representations. Existing ordered weighted graph models underlie the deformation. Potential implicit prior equivariant coverage remains a risk.
title: Full branch-and-particle symmetry of two-point star configurations
